−8 is further left, so −8 is the smaller number.

Write 7.1 times 10 to the power of negative 4 as an ordinary number.
You wrote 71000. You moved the digits 4 places to the left.
A common slip: 71000 is bigger than 7.1, but a negative power of 10 makes a number smaller.
Here is 7.1 in a place value table: 7 ones and 1 tenth. The tenths column is 10 to the power of negative 1.
Multiplying by 10 to the power of negative 4 is the same as dividing by 10000. Every digit moves 4 places to the right.
Zeros fill the empty places. So 7.1 times 10 to the power of negative 4 is 0.00071.

A price of £88 includes a 10% service charge. Work out the price before the service charge was added.
You found 10% of £88 and took it away, so you got £79.20.
A common slip: the 10% is a percentage of the price before the charge, not of £88.
Draw the price before the charge as 100%. Add 10%, and £88 is 110% of it.
£88 is 11 equal parts, each worth 10%. Each part is £88 divided by 11, which is £8.
100% is 10 parts, so the price before the charge was 10 times £8, which is £80.

beats.narration: Solve 6x − 5 = −29. That means finding the value of x.
You wrote x − 5 = −29/6, and then x = 1/6.
Set the equation out in two columns: 6x − 5 on the left side, −29 on the right side.
A common slip is dividing only some terms. You divided 6x and −29 by 6, but not the −5.
Undo the − 5 first, so there is only one term to divide. Add 5 to each side: 6x = −24.
Now divide the whole of each side by 6. That gives x = −4.
Solve 9x + 10 = 28. That means finding the value of x.
You wrote x + 10 = 28/9, and then x = −62/9.
Think of the equation as a balance: 9x + 10 on one side, 28 on the other.
A common slip is dividing only some terms. You divided 9x and 28 by 9, but not the 10.
Undo the + 10 first, so there is only one term to divide. Take 10 from each side: 9x balances 18.
Now divide the whole of each side by 9. One x balances 2, so x = 2.

Work out the gradient of the straight line through (−2, 1) and (1, −5).
You divided 3 by −6 and got −1/2.
Draw a right-angled triangle on the line. From the first point to the second, you go 6 down and 3 across.
A common slip is to divide across by up. That turns the gradient upside down.
Gradient is up divided by across, so the up number goes on top of the fraction.
Going down counts as negative, so up is −6. Then −6 divided by 3 is −2, so the gradient is −2.
